worksheets.title: Parts of a Whole — Picture It

items.prompt: A chocolate bar has 6 equal pieces. Color 2 pieces. Write the fraction that shows how many pieces are colored.
items.hint: The number of colored pieces goes on top (numerator). The total pieces go on the bottom (denominator).

items.prompt: Look at the circle below divided into 8 equal slices. If 3 slices are shaded, what fraction is shaded?
items.hint: Count the shaded slices for the numerator and total slices for the denominator.

items.prompt: Draw a rectangle and divide it into 4 equal parts. Shade 1 part. What fraction did you shade?
items.hint: You shaded 1 out of 4 total parts.

items.prompt: A strip of paper is cut into 5 equal sections. 4 sections are red. Write the fraction that represents the red part.
items.hint: Red sections = numerator, total sections = denominator.
